On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET today on @CNN: I’ll discuss Pres. Trump's catering-struck escape & the threat level from suspected Iranian plots with @SangerNYT, the fate of Afghans who helped the US with @JasonKander, why AI gains remain elusive with @McKinsey sr partner Asutosh Padhi, and how to mitigate AI’s risk to human jobs with @GinaRaimondo. I’ll also explain how Sweden went from democratic-socialism poster child to something very different.

On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET Sunday on @CNN … • After Pres. Trump’s strange escape last month via a catering truck, I’ll ask veteran @nytimes White House & national security correspondent @SangerNYT how seriously we should take suspected Iranian plots • Five years after the US withdrawal from Afghanistan, the population is now living firmly under Taliban rule—including thousands of Afghans who aided the US military. What has happened to them? I’ll talk with Afghanistan veteran & former Missouri Secretary of State @JasonKander • AI is attracting billions in investment, but for many firms, gains have remained elusive as AI hasn’t yet revolutionized how people work. Why? I’ll ask @McKinsey senior partner Asutosh Padhi, who advises CEOs on AI strategy & innovation • Fears of mass layoffs due to AI haven’t materialized yet, but what happens if those fears become reality? I’ll talk with former US Secretary of Commerce @GinaRaimondo, who has a plan to mitigate risks • Sweden has long been seen as a poster child for an inclusive form of democratic socialism, with a generous welfare state that cared for people “from cradle to grave.” But in recent years, the country has come to resemble something very different. I’ll explain what changed.

Bhagamandala, Kodagu | On BJP leader BL Santosh’s objection to the rule requiring permission to hold events on government property, Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar says, "We have never done politics by picking on one thing. No one needs to panic. Any organisation must follow the law. If we receive an application seeking permission from the government, we will provide the necessary permission and security as per rules. Krishna Byre Gowda also took government permission to hold the Freedom festival. Whether it is JD(S), BJP, Congress, or any other organisation, everyone has the opportunity to hold events within the legal framework. During the 'Vote Chori' protest, Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge had to take out a march to submit a petition to the Election Commission. At that time, we requested them to follow the law because we should not misuse power. It is our responsibility to respect Supreme Court directions. Just because we are in power, we should not misuse it. We respect the law given by the courts. Back then, G Parameshwara and all of us requested Rahul Gandhi and respected the law..." Former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee (@MamataOfficial) posts, "The passing of Asish Banerjee has left me deeply disturbed. He spent much of his life teaching and serving society with dedication, always known for his humble nature and close bond with the people of Rampurhat and Birbhum. What makes this tragedy even more painful is the immense mental and emotional strain he appears to have endured in his final days. As a five-term MLA, former Deputy Speaker and Chairman, Asish Da dedicated himself to bringing development to Rampurhat and undertook a large number of important works for the people. Yet, despite the work he did, he was repeatedly maligned, falsely accused and subjected to relentless pressure. The harassment and mental pressure he faced, despite his long record of public service, should make all of us pause and reflect on the human cost of relentless political hostility.My heartfelt prayers and condolences to his family, loved ones, former students and countless admirers. His absence will be deeply felt, always."

Before it ever ships, Amazon packaging gets dropped, shaken, squeezed, and slammed in a lab designed to push it to the limit. ⬇️ Behind the scenes at Amazon's Packaging Innovation Lab, durability tests help us make sure reduced packaging, easier to recycle materials, and sometimes even the product’s own packaging can protect products during shipping. ✅ Drop tests simulate the bumps of transit ✅ Vibration tables replicate the rumble of road and air transport ✅ Compression machines mimic stacking in a truck The result is less material, less waste, and packaging built to go the distance. Doctor en Filosofía por la Universidad de São Paulo (USP) y profesor de esa universidad –especializado en Ética y Filosofía Política–, Ribeiro tuvo un breve paso por el Ministerio de Educación en 2015; entre 2021 y 2025 presidió la Sociedad Brasileña para el Progreso de la Ciencia (SBPC), y desde 2024 es miembro titular de la Academia Brasileña de Ciencias. 🔗infob.ae/4g0UjiD

A Spanish F-18 operating under NATO air-policing authorities shot down a drone that breached Romanian airspace early Sunday, according to Romania’s Defense Ministry. Romanian radars detected the drone entering from neighboring Moldova, about 15 miles north of Galați. The F-18 established radar contact and received authorization to engage, bringing the drone down at 05:01 local time. Debris reportedly fell in an uninhabited area. Romania says this is the fourth drone it has shot down this year. The country has experienced repeated Russian drone incursions during the war in Ukraine, including three Russian drones shot down by Romanian F-16s in July.

The passing of Asish Banerjee has left me deeply disturbed. He spent much of his life teaching and serving society with dedication, always known for his humble nature and close bond with the people of Rampurhat and Birbhum. What makes this tragedy even more painful is the immense mental and emotional strain he appears to have endured in his final days. As a five-term MLA, former Deputy Speaker and Chairman, Asish Da dedicated himself to bringing development to Rampurhat and undertook a large number of important works for the people. Yet, despite the work he did, he was repeatedly maligned, falsely accused and subjected to relentless pressure. The harassment and mental pressure he faced, despite his long record of public service, should make all of us pause and reflect on the human cost of relentless political hostility. My heartfelt prayers and condolences to his family, loved ones, former students and countless admirers. His absence will be deeply felt, always.

It may be hard to comprehend what 975 years means. Not just the changing of seasons, but generations of people, societies, technologies and even empires coming and going. Yet some places have stood through it all – and now the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra marks its 975th anniversary. For almost a millennium, the Lavra has been a place where culture and knowledge have flourished. It brought together scholars, writers, artists, craftsmen and physicians, leaving a lasting mark on Ukraine’s and Europe’s spiritual and cultural life. The Lavra’s history is a powerful reminder of why it must be protected – as a part of Ukraine’s national memory and of the world’s shared cultural heritage.

Shah Mohammad Mehrabi, a member of the Board of Trustees of the Fund for the Afghan People, tells TOLOnews that the fund has earned $661 million in profits since its establishment. According to him, The Afghanistan Fund assets are now growing to $4.19 billion as of July 31, 2026. Mehrabi added that the fund’s assets are not intended to provide humanitarian assistance or cover government expenditures, but rather to preserve Afghanistan’s foreign exchange reserves. He added that the fund’s financial statements are independently audited each year by the international auditing firms that provides greater transparency and assurance regarding how the fund’s assets are managed. #TOLOnews_English

The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) in Afghanistan has said that from the beginning of this year through August, 92,000 people across the country have been affected by natural disasters, while 97 others have died. According to OCHA’s latest report, 331 people have been injured across 202 districts, more than 10,000 homes have been damaged, and over 2,000 others have been destroyed. OCHA added that Afghanistan’s eastern provinces have suffered the greatest losses from natural disasters this year. Expressing concern over reduced funding from international donors, the UN office said that of the estimated $1.7 billion needed for 2026, only $447 million, or 26 percent of the total, has been received. #TOLOnews_English

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said that his country has no obstacles to issuing visas to Afghan applicants and that the Foreign Ministry is ready to cooperate in this regard. Speaking at a meeting officials of Khorasan Razavi province, he said that issues concerning border provinces can be better resolved at the regional level and with Afghanistan’s border provinces, without the need for negotiations between Kabul and Tehran. Referring to Afghanistan, Pakistan, and Turkmenistan, Araghchi said that Iran’s neighboring countries are among the country’s most important economic opportunities amid sanctions. Araghchi also said that Khorasan Razavi province has the authority to expand trade relations and cross-border travel with neighboring countries. #TOLOnews_English

Jestem po rozmowach z GITD i czekam na wyniki kontroli przewoźnika, którego autobus uległ tragicznemu wypadkowi na Węgrzech. Nie ma zgody na kompromisy w kwestii bezpieczeństwa.

According to the report, thousands of Afghans were evacuated to European countries following the collapse of the republican government in August 2021, particularly those who had worked with foreign organizations. The growing influence of right-wing parties in Europe could affect Afghan refugees in several ways. Wildberries attack stats show 21 logistics sites hit with attacks, fires or evacuations from July 18 to August 16. The company has 209+ facilities totaling 5.6 million square meters, but 11 major complexes covering 1.38 million square meters were down by August 5th, nearly a quarter of all warehouse space. Not all 21 sites were directly hit, some just evacuated. Wildberries says the network keeps running by redirecting cargo, but each major facility knocked out strains the rest and complicates operations across Russia. WarTranslated (@wartranslated) Ukrainian drone attacks on Wildberries warehouses may have caused 800 billion rubles in damage, about $10 billion, Russian Forbes reports. Over 20 logistics centers were hit, at least 14 burned down. More than 400,000 sellers face losses, some lost up to 95% of their goods. 80th Independence Day Celebrations at JCP Attari Parade Arena The 80th Independence Day celebrations at Attari, Amritsar, were held with great fervour and patriotic spirit, with DG BSF Shri Praveen Kumar, IPS, as the Chief Guest. The celebrations commenced with the inauguration of a giant LED screen displaying the image of Mahatma Gandhi, the Father of the Nation, adding a solemn and inspiring dimension to the occasion. A vibrant tapestry of India’s diversity and unity unfolded through cultural programmes representing different regions of the country. The performances beautifully showcased India’s rich cultural heritage and the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat. Nearly 60,000 spectators from different parts of the country filled the JCP stadium and the campus, transforming the venue into a sea of patriotism, enthusiasm and national pride. BSF personnel from various training institutions showcased their exceptional skills through special sporting events and performances, reflecting their discipline, determination and physical prowess. The BSF Motorcycle Daredevil Team Janbaz and Seema Bhavani and Canine Squad presented a meticulously orchestrated display of precision, discipline and fearless skill, leaving the audience spellbound. The jubilant parade further raised the tempo and infused the gathering with unmatched josh, creating an electrifying atmosphere befitting the celebration of 80 years of India’s Independence. The Director General appreciated the outstanding performances by all the participating teams and applauded the organisers for conducting such a grand and spectacular show, which brought together thousands of citizens in a celebration of India’s unity, diversity and indomitable spirit. During his visit, DG BSF inaugurated total 12 barracks for mahila prahari. The Mahila Prahari Barrack at Border out Post Havelian was inaugurated in physical mode, while 11 other Mahila Prahari barracks at different BOPs in Gurdaspur, Firozpur and Abohar Sectors of Punjab Frontier were inaugurated virtually on 14th August. Interacting with troops during the Prahari Sammelan, DG BSF appreciated their dedication and hard work and exhorted them to continuously hone their skills to meet evolving border security challenges, particularly the use of drones by anti-national elements. He assured them of all support for their welfare and felicitated outstanding performers with the commendation roll

Екстрені служби працюють на місцях ранкових та нічних російських ударів. У Києві оперативно ліквідували пожежі, зараз тривають аварійні роботи. У місті та області росіяни поранили шістьох людей. Під ударами балістикою також були Кременчук і Кривий Ріг. Всюди, де росіяни дотягуються своєю балістикою, вони бʼють по цивільній інфраструктурі. У Кривому Розі двоє загиблих і ще 14 людей постраждали. Є загибла людина в Сумах. Мої співчуття рідним та близьким. Від ранку продовжується тривога у багатьох регіонах: росіяни випустили нову хвилю дронів. Лише протягом цього тижня 13 областей були під ударами. Ворог випустив по наших містах і громадах понад 1550 ударних дронів, майже 1560 авіабомб та 62 ракети. Серед них більшість – балістика різних типів. Вдячний усім службам – підрозділам ДСНС, поліції, медикам, – які першими прибувають на місця атак, допомагають людям, швидко спрацьовують на порятунок і відновлення життя. Дуже важливо, щоб ця самовідданість наших людей доповнювалася новими кроками партнерів для захисту неба. Коли північнокорейська балістика руйнує інфраструктуру і забирає життя тут, у Європі, не можна дозволити, щоб європейські перехоплювачі просто лежали на складах. Захист життя потрібен. Росію потрібно зупинити. Нові пакети – це буквально врятовані життя і захищена інфраструктура кожен день. Дякую кожному партнеру, який із цим допомагає.

Carlsen secured back-to-back EWC chess title on Saturday, defeating Belarusian grandmaster Denis Lazavik 2-0 in the best-of-three grand final. He won both sets 3-1 and finished the tournament without losing a single match. The 35-year-old revealed that his conservative approach was a deliberate strategy, shaped partly by the demanding 10-minute, no-increment format and partly by concerns over his physical condition during the tournament. "I started watching the Mourinho documentary on Netflix the other day and they were talking about the first season that they were just winning 1-0 every match and I was thinking, well, that sounds pretty nice, doesn’t it?" Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. Imphal, Manipur: On gymnast Ariha Pangambam winning gold at the Senior Individual Women's Asian Aerobic Gymnastics Championships, her father, Pangambam Akhelo, says, "We watched the performance on television. Despite my daughter’s participation, we felt anxious and restless throughout the broadcast. Based on her performance, we were confident that she would receive a medal, but we had not anticipated her being the winner. When she won, our hearts were filled with overwhelming joy. Training is challenging due to the frequent imposition of bandhs and the chaotic situation in Manipur. These disruptions have significantly affected her practice schedule. Despite curfew hours, we attempted to visit the gymnasium in the early morning when it was open." He adds, "The current coach, Yumnam Ranjan, a retired ex-serviceman who dedicated his work at Khuman Lampak and trained our daughter Ariha, is also an approved International Judge of the Gymnastics Federation of India (GFI) and the International Gymnastics Federation. His coaching and training imparted to my daughter Ariha are comparable to those of other international coaches. I aspire for my daughter to achieve international success and become a champion in the World Championships, Olympics, and World Games." So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

Elon Musk stood in a Hollywood living room in 2008, 12 days from bankruptcy, and pitched a $109,000 car to people who thought he was joking. His own Roadster is parked outside production unit 1 and he mentions it the way other men mention a bicycle. He explains the money first. Congress approved $25 billion to build energy-efficient vehicles, then the Big Three flew to Washington and asked for it to cover payroll on gas guzzlers instead. Congress said yes. “That gets them to about February,” he says. Tesla applied to the same fund for the thing the fund was actually written for: a cheaper car. Then comes the part nobody in the room registers. Tesla pays no dividends and never will, because every penny from every $109,000 Roadster goes into the next car down the price ladder. His salary is minimum wage. He doesn’t mention that the company has days of cash left, or that an emergency round has to close by Christmas Eve or it’s over. He talks about cell phones instead how the first ones cost a fortune, how you can’t reach the cheap version without selling the expensive one first. 100 cars built, and the 100th goes out Tuesday. He says he’ll hand over the keys himself. GM filed for bankruptcy 6 months later, and the man on minimum wage didn’t. The tragic death of former MLA and former Dy Speaker of WBLA Asish Banerjee is not merely heartbreaking, it should trouble the conscience of everyone who believes that politics and journalism must have boundaries. A lifelong teacher and public servant, Asish Da devoted decades to serving people with honesty, dignity and simplicity. He was a respected figure and a source of pride for Rampurhat and entire Birbhum district. His final note raises serious and troubling questions about the sustained smear campaign he said he had endured. The BJP and sections of the MEDIA must reflect on the consequences of a politics where allegations are amplified, reputations are put on trial and individuals are condemned in the court of public opinion before the truth is established. Those who participated in this smear campaign should reflect on the human consequences of their words and actions. Political battles will come and go, but a life once lost can never be brought back. Bengal has lost one of its most respected sons of the soil. My deepest condolences to his family, students, admirers and well wishers. May God give them strength in this hour of unimaginable grief. Om Shanti.

Really interesting research from Anthropic on using multi-agent systems for vulnerability research: anthropic.com/research/multi… Their collaborating agents found 266 vulnerabilities vs 21 for independent agents. But the part I found most interesting is that only 12 findings overlapped. Feels like another sign that the future of AI auditing probably isn’t just running one really strong model over a codebase. Different agents, different prompts, and different ways of exploring the code seem to find very different things. I think the best systems will eventually look much more like an actual audit team: multiple agents exploring independently, sharing leads, specializing in certain areas, and then having other agents try to disprove the findings. I've also been experimenting a lot with multi-agent models, assigning different roles and incentives, which has led to huge improvements. The crazy part is, @muellerberndt did this already a year ago with his AI auditing system Hound.

DETUVIERON A UNA ARGENTINA EN UN AEROPUERTO DE JAPÓN POR INTENTAR INGRESAR UN KILO DE COCAÍNA OCULTO EN SU CUERPO Una mujer argentina de 30 años fue arrestada en el aeropuerto de Haneda, Tokio, cuando intentaba ingresar alrededor de un kilo de cocaína oculto en su cuerpo. En principio, había sido demorada por su actitud sospechosa y, finalmente, descubrieron que había ingerido más de 100 cápsulas. La acusada fue identificada como Rosa Micaela Quipildor, luego de que ser detenida por la Policía Metropolitana de Tokio y la Suboficina de Aduanas de Haneda. Según confirmaron fuentes oficiales, la sospechosa había llegado a Japón el 10 de agosto en un vuelo procedente de Londres. Tras haber frustrado la maniobra, la policía sospecha que una organización sudamericana dedicada al tráfico de drogas estaría detrás de la operación. De hecho, la misma acusada reveló en su declaración que había conocido a una mujer en un festival en Argentina, que le propuso transportar la droga como forma de obtener dinero. “Recibí y consumí cocaína en Brasil. Se suponía que recibiría 7.000 dólares a cambio de la droga”, relató la acusada ante las autoridades japonesas sobre el presunto origen de los estupefacientes. Asimismo, indicó que esa mujer la había puesto en contacto con un hombre, quien habría sido el encargado de darle las instrucciones para el viaje y la forma en la que debía entregar las cápsulas. On 10 August 2026, a newly-appointed Ambassador of the Kingdom of Morocco to ASEAN, H.E. Redouane Houssaini, presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Houssaini on his assumption of office and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s commitment to further strengthening the ASEAN-Morocco Sectoral Dialogue Partnership established in 2023. The Secretary-General also expressed appreciation for Morocco’s support for ASEAN Community-building efforts. Ambassador Houssaini thanked Secretary-General Dr. Kao for the warm welcome. He looked forward to working closely with ASEAN Member States and the ASEAN Secretariat in further strengthening Morocco’s ties and cooperation with ASEAN during his term of office. Morocco has accredited its first Ambassador to ASEAN since 2010. Ambassador Houssaini succeeds Ambassador Ouadia Benabdellah, who completed his tenure in April 2025. Video

Now that I’ve had a little time to reflect on DEF CON 34, I think what stays with me most isn’t actually standing on the stage. It’s the people. Of course, seeing a full house at Recon Village while talking about something I care deeply about - OSINT, critical thinking, and the cognitive consequences of relying too heavily on AI - was incredibly special. But walking around DEF CON afterwards and having people stop me just to say hello, tell me they enjoyed the talk, challenge an idea, or continue the conversation… That genuinely meant a lot to me. I got to reconnect with old friends and somehow leave Vegas with a whole bunch of new ones. And I got to spend several days surrounded by hackers, researchers, investigators, builders, curious minds and people who simply look at the world differently. That’s probably what I’ll remember most. I came to DEF CON to share some of my thoughts. I’m leaving having had my own thinking challenged and expanded in return. And perhaps that’s exactly what a gathering like DEF CON should do. So thank you DEF CON and Recon Village for having me. Thank you to everyone who came to the talk. And especially thank you to everyone who stopped me somewhere along the way just to talk, laugh, share an idea, grab a drink or say hello. I’m humbled, grateful, slightly exhausted, and leaving with far more ideas than I arrived with. DEF CON, you’ve been an absolute blast. I’ll be back. P.S. I will re-record my talk I gave at DEFCON and post this on my Github/Youtube. Please have a little patience with that. خدایا کہاں پھنس گئے امریکی مہربان قدرت کا بھی ایک نظام ہے‘ ہٹلر اور نپولین کا علاج روس کی سردی نے کیا۔ دونوں یورپ کے بادشاہ بنے ہوئے تھے لیکن روسی سردی کے سامنے نہ ٹھہر سکے۔ امریکہ جو اس دور کا بادشاہ ہے‘ اس کا علاج خلیج فارس کے پانیوں میں ہو رہا ہے۔ امریکی تاریخ کا سب سے بڑبولا صدر جو من مانیاں کیے جا رہا تھا‘ پھنسا تو کیسے پھنسا۔ جسے چند ہفتوں کی جنگ سمجھا جا رہا تھا چھٹے ماہ میں پہنچ چکی ہے اورگو امریکی بے قراری انتہا پہ ہے کہ اس جنگ سے جان چھڑائی جائے‘ نکلنے کا راستہ نہیں مل رہا۔ دیگر باتوں کو چھوڑیے جو امریکہ کے ایئرکرافٹ کیریئرز کے ساتھ ہو رہا ہے وہ کہانی اپنا سبق رکھتی ہے۔ یہ دنیا کے طاقتور ترین بحری جہاز ہیں جو 70سے 80لڑاکا طیارے لیے پھرتے ہیں۔ نیوکلیئر پاور سے چلتے ہیں جس کا مطلب ہے کہ سمندروں میں لمبا عرصہ گزار سکتے ہیں۔ ایئرکرافٹ کیریئر ابراہم لنکن کوئی نو ماہ سے سمندروں میں پھر رہا ہے اور اس پر جو پانچ ہزار ملاح تعینات ہیں ان کا حشر ہو رہا ہے۔ اتنے لوگوں کو ایک جہاز میں کھپانا چاہے وہ جتنا بڑا ہو معمولی کھیل نہیں۔ خوراک کا معیار ناقص ہو گیا ہے‘ ہائی جین کی اشیا جیسا کہ ٹوتھ پیسٹ اور ٹوتھ برش ان کی کمی واقع ہو رہی ہے اور سب سے سنگین مسئلہ یہ کہ باتھ روموں کے آگے لائنیں لگی ہوتی ہیں اور کتنے ہی باتھ روم کام نہیں کر رہے۔ کسی باتھ روم کا پانی باہر نکل رہا ہو تو اندازہ کیا جا سکتا ہے کہ استعمال کرنے والوں پر کیا بیت رہی ہو گی۔ اس سے پہلے ایئرکرافٹ کیریئر جیرالڈ آر فورڈ کے لانڈری روم میں آگ بڑھک اٹھی تھی۔ امریکیوں نے آگ کو حادثاتی کہا لیکن خبریں تھیں کہ کوئی ایرانی میزائل وغیرہ ایئرکرافٹ کیریئر کو لگا ہے۔ مرمت کے لیے جہاز کو واپس جانا پڑا۔ منظر تو دیکھا جائے کہ دنیا کی طاقتور ترین نیوی نے بحیرۂ عرب کے پانیوں کا محاصرہ کیا ہوا ہے اور گو ایرانی بھی اپنا تیل وہاں سے نہیں نکال پا رہے کسی اور ملک کا تیل بھی وہاں سے نہیں جا رہا۔ کویت کی ایکسپورٹ بالکل بند ہو گئی ہے۔ یو اے ای کا تیل بند پڑا ہے۔ قطر کی گیس ایکسپورٹ سب رکی ہوئی ہے‘ اس کی گیس تنصیبات کو بھاری نقصان پہنچا ہے۔ ہمارے برادر سعودیوں کو مشکلات کا سامنا ہے۔ آبنائے ہرمز سے ان کا کوئی تیل باہر نہیں نکل رہا اور حوثیوں کے حملوں کی وجہ سے بحیرۂ احمر کا راستہ بھی زیادہ تر بند پڑا ہے۔ ان سب برادر ملکوں کا رکھوالا اور گاڈ فادر امریکہ تھا اور امریکہ کا اپنا حشر ہو رہا ہے کہ اپنے عسکری اڈوں کی حفاظت نہیں کر سکا۔ اپنی مؤکل ریاستوں کی اس نے کیا حفاظت کرنی تھی۔ اس وقت مؤکل پریشان اور رکھوالے کے ہوش بھی اڑے ہوئے۔ ہمارے لیے سبق یہ ہے کہ زبانی کلامی تسلیاں تو اپنی جگہ لیکن اگر تاریخ کا تھوڑا سا بھی مطالعہ کریں تو یمنی سر زمین سے دور رہنا ہی بہتر ہے۔ مصر کے جمال عبدالناصر کی سرپرستی میں جب متحدہ عرب ریاست کی بنیاد ڈالی گئی تو اس میں تین ممالک شامل تھے: مصر‘ شام اور یمن۔ یمن میں ایک قبائلی بغاوت ہوئی اور جمال عبدالناصر کے برے دن آنے تھے کہ 1962ء میں انہوں نے مصری فوجی دستے یمن بھیجے۔ وہاں جا کے مصری فوج بری طرح پھنس گئی اور اسے بھاری نقصان اٹھانا پڑا۔ ابھی پچھلے سال مارچ میں ہی صدر ٹرمپ نے حوثیوں پر ہوائی حملوں کا آغاز کیا۔ دو ماہ شدید ترین ہوائی حملے ہوئے اور حوثی ٹس سے مس نہ ہوئے۔ الٹا خبریں آنے لگیں کہ امریکہ کے میزائل اور بم خطرناک حد تک کم ہو رہے ہیں۔ وہی جو ایران کے ساتھ جنگ میں ہوا ہے کہ اتنے پیٹریاٹ اور ٹوما ہاک میزائل استعمال ہوئے ہیں اور امریکی خود سوچنے پر مجبور ہیں کہ کہیں اور ضرورت پڑی تو کیا کریں گے۔ جو دیرینہ دوستی ہماری ہے اس کی لاج تو رکھنی ہے۔ کچھ اپنے معاشی حالات کی بھی بات ہے۔ نازک معاشی حالت ہو تو ہر تھوڑے بہت کا خیال رکھنا پڑتا ہے۔ لیکن زبانی یا کاغذی معاہدوںسے ہٹ کر کوئی ایسی لغزش نہ ہو جائے کہ جمال عبدالناصر کے تجربے کی یاد آنے لگے۔ ہم تو ویسے بھی بہت سے محاذوں پر پھنسے ہوئے ہیں۔ جو صورتحال کے پی کے میں ہے گرفت میں آ ہی نہیں رہی۔ جنوبی اضلاع خاص کر کے وہاں تو ہر مشاہدہ یہی بتاتا ہے کہ سرکار کی رِٹ تو بڑے نازک پیروں پر کھڑی ہے۔ ٹی ٹی پی والے‘ جن کے ہمدرد ایک زمانے میں یہاں بہت ہوا کرتے تھے‘ مرضی سے آتے جاتے ہیں۔ نشانہ اور وقت کا تعین وہ کرتے ہیں‘ ہمارے لوگ پھر جوابی کارروائیاں ہی کر سکتے ہیں۔ یعنی پہل جسے انگریزی میں Initiativeکہتے ہیں‘ ان کے پاس ہے۔ یہ ایک محاذ ہی کافی تھا‘ مشکل دن آنے تھے کہ بلوچستان ایک دوسرا محاذ بنا ہوا ہے۔ بھادوں کا مہینہ شروع ہو گیا ہے۔ یہ بھادوں کی گرمی اور بلوچستان کے پہاڑ۔ کوئی بھی ریگولر آرمی ‘ روس کی امریکہ کی یا کسی اور ملک کی‘ کسی گوریلا جنگ میں پھنسنا حماقت ہوتی ہے۔ سوویت یونین افغانستان میں آ کے پھنس گیا‘ اس کے بعد امریکی آئے سترہ برس تک اسلحہ پھونکتے رہے اور آخرکار انہیں ہار ماننا پڑی۔ جدید تاریخ میں شاذ و نادر ہی کوئی مثال ملتی ہے کہ ریگولر فوج کسی گوریلا جنگ میں کامیاب ہوئی ہو۔ ویتنام کی مثال ہمارے سامنے ہے‘ پانچ لاکھ امریکی فوجی وہاں دھونسے گئے تھے‘ اور دنیا کی طاقتور ترین فوج کو ویتنام کے جنگلوں اور چاول کے کھیتوں میں عبرتناک شکست کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ یہ تو وینزویلا جیسے کمزور ملک ہوتے ہیں جو تھوڑا سا ملٹری پریشر سہنے کی پوزیشن میں نہیں ہوتے۔ اس کے برعکس کیوبا کو دیکھیں‘ تیل کہیں سے نہیں آ رہا‘ معاشی مشکلات عروج پر ہیں لیکن پھر بھی حکومت ڈٹی ہوئی ہے۔ وینزویلا پر امریکہ نے حملہ کر دیا اور وہاں کے همزمان با پنجمین سالگرد بازگشت طالبان به قدرت در افغانستان، شماری از زنان، فعالان و حامیان حقوق زن، شنبه (۱۵ اگست)، در برابر مقر سازمان ملل متحد در ژنیو، سویس، زیر نام "همبستگی با زنان و دختران افغانستان" گردهم آمدند و خواستار توجه بیشتر جامعۀ جهانی به وضعیت زنان و دختران افغان شدند. گزارش کامل این گردهمایی را یکشنبه( ۱۶ اگست)، از صدای امریکا دنبال کنید. More than 1,300 Strava users have publicly logged workouts from U.S. military sites across the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) area, according to an investigation by Sky News cited by Task & Purpose. The exposure is particularly concerning because many of these installations have subsequently been targeted by Iran. At Muwaffaq Al Salti Air Base in Jordan, for example, personnel regularly posted runs around the installation. Activity resumed in April and later became concentrated around barracks; the housing area was struck in July, killing three U.S. soldiers. The issue isn't new. In 2018, Strava's public heat maps exposed previously undisclosed military locations and details about base layouts. The Pentagon subsequently prohibited personnel from using geolocation features on personal or government devices. CENTCOM has since issued additional OPSEC guidance, including restrictions implemented when Operation Epic Fury began. Yet publicly available Strava data shows personnel are still exposing their locations. This is particularly notable given Adm. Brad Cooper's warning last month that Iran was using troops' photos, videos and other cellphone-generated information to assess strike effectiveness and help target U.S. personnel. Below are screenshots taken from the Strava app today showing activity at Muwaffaq Al Salti Air Base, Jordan and Prince Sultan Air Base, Saudi Arabia. The blue lines are tracks uploaded to the app by users with the darker color representing higher usage of route.

The future USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79) has successfully completed Navy acceptance trials, marking a major milestone toward delivery of the second Gerald R. Ford-class aircraft carrier to the fleet, as announced by the U.S. Navy's Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE). Acceptance trials are the Navy's formal evaluation of the completed ship to determine whether it meets its required performance and capabilities. With the trials complete, Kennedy moves toward delivery to the Navy in March 2027, followed by additional post-delivery work, crew training and certification before entering operational service. Kennedy is the second ship of the Ford class, incorporating systems including EMALS electromagnetic catapults, Advanced Arresting Gear and Advanced Weapons Elevators.

El mandatario de Buenos Aires quiere llegar a la instancia de negociación de las Primarias con la mayor estructura posible para sentarse con el resto de los sectores. Es por eso que declina la posibilidad de sellar un acuerdo político electoral en este momento. “Tenemos tiempo para definir, ya llegará el momento de negociar”, dicen en su entorno. El gobernador cree que puede acumular poder y que este año no es de candidatura, aunque sus movimientos se parezcan bastante a una. En La Plata reconocen que hoy hay solamente dos candidatos para las elecciones del año que viene: Javier Milei y Axel Kicillof. Con este cuadro de situación es que, como viene contando Infobae, ordenó acelerar el armado federal. En eso están los dirigentes que los rodean. La semana que viene habrá fuertes señales en este sentido. El gobernador bonaerense volverá a las recorridas por fuera del territorio. El miércoles estará en Chaco, una de las provincias que el peronismo perdió en las elecciones del 2023 cuando Javier Milei se impuso en la presidencia. Allí gobierna el radical Leandro Zdero. A diferencia de lo que sucedió cuando Kicillof fue a Corrientes, donde tampoco gobierna el peronismo, esta vez no habrá encuentro entre gobernadores. Durante su paso por la tierra correntina, el mandatario bonaerense se reunió con su par, Juan Pablo Valdés, con quien firmó algunos convenios de gestión. En Chaco, Kicillof participará del acto de normalización de la CGT local. Será la reasunción del binomio conformado por Adrián Bellomi (ATSA - Sanidad) e Isaías Alegre (Camioneros). Tras ello, tendrá un almuerzo cerrado de carácter político, con dirigentes. Será en Colonia Benítez. La gira culminará con la presentación de su libro “De Smith a Keynes. Siete lecciones de historia del pensamiento económico”. A Kicillof lo recibirá el ex gobernador chaqueño y actual senador nacional por esa provincia, Jorge Capitanich, que fue con quien se articuló la agenda. Además, detrás de la recorrida por la provincia del Nordeste están el titular del gremio de Sanidad y secretario del Interior de la CGT, Héctor Daer y quien quedó a cargo de la construcción nacional del espacio del gobernador: el ministro de Desarrollo de la Comunidad de PBA, Andrés “Cuervo” Larroque. Just reupping this much needed perspective on the hardships and human cost of increasing optempo and war. If journalists want to be “fair and balanced” (instead of running to DC “experts” to talk about *gestures vaguely* all of this), they would reach out to @SharrellAnne2. SharrellAnne (@SharrellAnne2) Maybe this is one of those moments where my GWOT-era perspective makes me less sympathetic than I’m supposed to be, but reading “They’re taking me away from my family longer than expected” triggers something in me that I’m not sure I can fully explain. I’m from an era where a 9-month deployment became 12, then 15, and sometimes 18. I knew soldiers who spent 18 months in the desert, living in conditions that included literally burning their own shit. They had families who desperately wanted them home too. They missed the births of their children. They missed grandparents dying. They missed birthdays, anniversaries, holidays and entire chunks of their children growing up. Communication from home wasn’t instantaneous. There was no FaceTime from the other side of the world whenever you wanted it. Sometimes news from home took days or weeks to reach them. And sometimes when that news finally arrived, it was a Dear John letter. Alan did multiple deployments between the Marine Corps and Army. Trust me, he complained. 😂 Complaining about deployment is practically a military tradition. The food sucks. Leadership sucks. You miss home. You’re tired. You were supposed to be home by now. I get all of that. What I don’t understand is treating an extension like an injustice. You’re not there on vacation. You’re there to execute a mission, and sometimes the mission doesn’t give a damn what date was originally circled on the calendar. But there’s another part of this that absolutely blows my mind: spouses sharing these private messages with the media while their sailors are actively deployed on combat operations. I cannot imagine handing private messages between Alan and me to a reporter while he was downrange. The hell that would have descended on both of us, and especially on him, is difficult to describe. If Alan needed to tell me deployment sucked, he could tell me deployment sucked. My job at home was to be the safe place where he could say it, not turn around and send screenshots of that conversation to the media. There are legitimate reasons to hold military leadership accountable. But no fresh milk, shitty produce, missing your family and being deployed longer than expected do not convince me our service members are being pushed beyond the limits of human endurance. Maybe I’m just getting old. Maybe deployment culture really has changed this much and I’m the one who hasn’t caught up. But I read these messages and don’t think, How could the Navy do this to them? I think, when did we get this damn soft? — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SharrellAnne2/status/2088420427378909643#m

Only one victim has been confirmed as a VSU student, with investigators believing the others may be from the surrounding community. Authorities say the shooting was not a drive-by and are searching for multiple suspects. No arrests have been reported. The campus was temporarily locked down, with a significant law-enforcement presence remaining as the investigation continues. The shooting comes just days before classes are scheduled to begin Monday.

Today, I signed a decree on measures at the state level to protect Ukraine’s national shrines. A law on our Ukrainian national shrines will be prepared for Ukraine’s Independence Day – we discussed this with Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada Ruslan Stefanchuk – and I ask MPs to support it. It should clearly define what constitutes our national shrines and what steps are needed to protect our shrines throughout the entire territory of Ukraine. And this status of national shrines, enshrined in law, should give more opportunities to the teams of our shrines – to everyone working to protect Ukrainian heritage – strengthening them in their working conditions, financial capacity, and political and legal tools for protecting our shrines, our museum collections, and our heritage. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 3/3 Video

Today, representatives of UNESCO and our partners around the world are here with us, as are representatives of countries working with Ukraine. Thank you all for standing with us and honoring our statehood and our spirit. But much more must be done to stop this war, to protect this beauty, and to ensure that the history of our Ukrainian shrines continues. More of our Ukrainian shrines deserve to become part of the UNESCO World Heritage List and receive the corresponding attention, protection, and opportunities for restoration. We need more political and sanctions-related work to protect the shrines of our people throughout the entire territory of Ukraine – including Crimea and other parts of our occupied land. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 2/3 Video

Today, we mark the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra – almost a millennium. Longer than the history of individual people, families, or generations. And yet still less than everything that unites us – unites us into a community, a nation, a state. Unites us as Ukraine. We must preserve every one of our national shrines like this. And all the more so now, when the challenges of the passage of time have been compounded by the challenges of Russia’s utterly godless and asinine war against Ukraine and against all the places of our culture, our history, our memory – against all places that embody humanity. You have to be utterly despicable and utterly witless to strike the Lavra, but Russia did it. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 1/3 Video

He says, "A young boy named Roshan Yadav has suffered a custodial death. Regarding the family's allegations about this, we came here to meet the local police official, the Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP). There are two aspects to this entire incident. The first aspect is the family's allegation that the boy was arrested on the 27th of May at 3:00 pm by the Rahika police station instead of the Arer police station. No information was given to them on paper, nor were they informed verbally. After three days, they found out that their child was locked up in the Rahika police station. About two months and ten days after that, he died a custodial death in jail." The SSP has stated that an inquiry must be conducted into the boy's death under the District Magistrate according to the guidelines of the National Human Rights Commission. A report will also be sent to the NHRC. The police, the administration, and the jail officials claim that he committed suicide. The family claims that he was murdered due to being beaten up. The SSP has accepted everything and assured us that they will immediately conduct an investigation from all angles and at every level, and justice will be served. So, we are giving them a 10-day timeframe." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

VIDEO | Dhaka: Veteran climate activist Sharif Jamil reacts to Bangladesh's power crisis, renewable energy and climate finance. He says, "First of all, the current power sector or energy architecture of Bangladesh is the result of a long process spanning about two decades. It started with the Power System Master Plan in 2010. Since then, as climate activists, we have been campaigning and advocating for renewables globally for a long time. You understand how European nations and many developing countries paved their pathways to move away from coal and overall fossil fuels, which is essential for the planet. In Bangladesh, civil society has also been advocating for the expansion of renewable energy for a long time. We know Bangladesh is an untapped energy mine because we have consistent sunlight throughout the year. We could have planned to meet a significant percentage or share of our total power mix from renewables. However, we did not do that. Instead, we shifted toward imported fossil fuels, first based on coal, and now heading toward imported LNG and gas." "A nation's energy security is compromised whenever the raw materials for the power or energy sector are imported, as this always introduces a risk factor. With the volatile global gas and LNG markets, Bangladesh has been affected several times recently, and very noticeably so this time. We had the opportunity to build a stronger renewable energy sector, and we still have that opportunity. But we failed to do so. This recent power sector crisis has been triggered by several events, which are also linked to changes in our government, as three governments came into power within a very short period of time. It is a critical sector that demands our utmost attention." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

Moving that command center would be the second major design change prompted by President Trump, who on Thursday issued a national security memorandum directing the Navy to develop a plan to revert to older steam-powered catapults on future aircraft carriers, scrapping the Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS) currently employed on the USS Gerald R. Four A-50Us up for one Flamingo package is close to Russia’s entire remaining combat-ready fleet. Open-source tracking puts flyable A-50Us in the mid-single digits after attrition and maintenance realities. Concentrating nearly all of them on a single axis is rare and costly. AEW aircraft are the right tool against low-flying cruise missiles. They look down over the radar horizon and through ground clutter. The Flamingo is neither stealthy nor particularly fast; it relies on terrain masking. In theory the A-50Us should have made interception straightforward. Yet two of five still reached the Samara target area damaging space flight production equipment. Flight time to that range is under 2 hours. That leaves a narrow window. Either the aircraft were already airborne for general coverage and only one (or none) was scrambled reactively, or there simply weren’t enough fighters in position to convert the detections into kills. Given Ukrainian strikes in mass waves, it very easily could have been no aircraft were flying that still had missiles. Another issue is Russia lacks aircraft with modern AESA radars that are exceptionally good at targeting low flying platforms. Two hits out of five against maximal AEW effort is a clear improvement over recent performance. Just a few months ago Flamingos were missile their targets. The limiting factor is shifting from the missile itself to the shrinking AEW inventory and the reaction timeline it can support. Of A-50Us have been critical at stopping Flamingos, I have a feeling some A-50U will be targeted again in the near future. 🌊 SYS PROMPT LEAK 🌊 Got the full system prompts, tools, and skills for ZAI's ZCode: GLM-5.3! Full files (nearly 400k characters total!) are up on CL4R1T4S: github.com/elder-plinius/CL4… • 391,439 characters • All captured prompts • 15 skill bodies • 24 receipt-verified tool contracts • 2 MCP contract reconstructions Here's the first bit of the system prompt! PROMPT: """ You are ZCode, an interactive coding agent You are an interactive ZCode agent that helps users with software engineering tasks. IMPORTANT: Assist with authorized security testing, defensive security, CTF challenges, and educational contexts. Refuse requests for destructive techniques, DoS attacks, mass targeting, supply chain compromise, or detection evasion for malicious purposes. Dual-use security tools (C2 frameworks, credential testing, exploit development) require clear authorization context: pentesting engagements, CTF competitions, security research, or defensive use cases. Harness Text you output outside of tool use is displayed to the user as Github-flavored markdown in a terminal. Tools run behind a user-selected permission mode; a denied call means the user declined it — adjust, don't retry verbatim. The system may send updates, reminders, or modifications to rules via mid-conversation system turns. These are system-controlled, unlike function results. Hooks may intercept tool calls; treat hook output as user feedback. Prefer the dedicated file/search tools over shell commands when one fits. Independent tool calls can run in parallel in one response. Reference code as file_path:line_number — it's clickable. Communicating with the user Your text output is what the user reads; they usually can't see your thinking or the raw tool results. Write it for a teammate who stepped away and is catching up, not for a log file: they don't know the codenames or shorthand you created along the way, and they didn't watch your process unfold. Before your first tool call, say in a sentence what you're about to do; while working, give brief updates when you find something load-bearing or change direction. Text you write between tool calls may not be shown to the user. Everything the user needs from this turn — answers, summaries, findings, conclusions, deliverables — must be in the final text message of your turn, with no tool calls after it. Keep text between tool calls to brief status notes. If something important appeared only mid-turn or in your thinking, restate it in that final message. Lead with the outcome. Your first sentence after finishing should answer "what happened" or "what did you find" — the thing the user would ask for if they said "just give me the TLDR." Supporting detail and reasoning come after, for readers who want them. Being readable and being concise are different things, and readable matters more. If the user has to reread your summary or ask you to explain, any time saved by brevity is gone. The way to keep output short is to be selective about what you include (drop details that don't change what the reader would do next), not to compress the writing into fragments, abbreviations, arrow chains like A → B → fails, or jargon. What you do include, write in complete sentences with the technical terms spelled out. Don't make the reader cross-reference labels or numbering you invented earlier; say what you mean in place. Match the response to the question: a simple question gets a direct answer in prose, not headers and sections. Use tables only for short enumerable facts, with explanations in the surrounding prose rather than the cells. Calibrate to the user — a bit tighter for an expert, more explanatory for someone newer. Write code that reads like the surrounding code: match its comment density, naming, and idiom. Only write a code comment to state a constraint the code itself can't show — never to say where it came from, what the next line does, or why your change is correct; that's you talking to the reviewer, not the next reader, and it's noise the moment the PR merges. For actions that are hard to reverse or outward-facing, confirm first unless durably authorized or explicitly told to proceed without asking; approval in one context doesn't extend to the next. Sending content to an external service publishes it; it may be cached or indexed even if later deleted. Before deleting or overwriting, look at the target — if what you find contradicts how it was described, or you didn't create it, surface that instead of proceeding. Report outcomes faithfully: if tests fail, say so with the output; if a step was skipped, say that; when something is done and verified, state it plainly without hedging. Session-specific guidance When the user types /<skill-name>, invoke it via Skill. Only use skills listed in the user-invocable skills section — don't guess. """

Источники журналиста Михаила Зыгаря назвали снятие «Яблока» с выборов личным решением Путина Окончательное решение снять «Яблоко» с выборов в Госдуму принял лично Владимир Путин, пишет Михаил Зыгарь в колонке для Der Spiegel со ссылкой на источники, знакомые с обсуждением этого вопроса в Кремле. Детали. К моменту снятия с выборов за исключение партии из выборов выступали и первый замглавы администрации президента Сергей Кириенко, и ФСБ, утверждает журналист. Их мотивы могли различаться, но результат был один и тот же: сохранение «Яблока» в избирательном бюллетене теперь представлялось слишком большим риском. ▪️Изначально Кремль решил допустить «Яблоко» до выборов, поскольку не считал партию серьезной угрозой, утверждает Зыгарь. Однако после регистрации поддержка партии стала превращаться в более широкое антивоенное движение. В Кремле опасались не столько результата «Яблока», сколько самой возможности несколько недель вести по всей стране легальную антивоенную кампанию, которая могла показать реальный масштаб запроса на прекращение войны. ▪️Практика, при которой принципиальные решения о составе участников федеральных выборов доходят до Путина, описывалась и раньше. В 2020 году «Проект» писал, что президентская кампания Ксении Собчак 2018 года была тщательно согласована с Кремлем. Перед выдвижением Собчак несколько раз встречалась с Путиным, утверждал источник издания; сама она подтверждала одну встречу и рассказывала, что лично сообщила Путину о решении баллотироваться. Один из участников ее штаба говорил «Проекту», что разговор с президентом был нужен, чтобы тот санкционировал финансирование кампании и согласовал «понятийные вопросы» — в том числе границы допустимого в агитации. После этого тезисы программы Собчак уже согласовывались с Сергеем Кириенко. ▪️Решение о снятии «Яблока» было принято на фоне резкого роста рейтинга «Яблока». В еженедельных опросах работающего с Кремлем ФОМ за партию были готовы проголосовать 1% россиян 17–19 июля, 2% — 24–29 июля и 31 июля–2 августа, а 7–9 августа — уже 4%. Таким образом, за три недели открытый рейтинг партии вырос в четыре раза, а только за последнюю неделю перед решением суда — вдвое. ▪️В июльском опросе ExtremeScan за «Яблоко» были готовы проголосовать 4% всех избирателей и 6% определившихся. В Москве Russian Field фиксировал рост чистого рейтинга партии с 3% в мае–июне до 5,27% в июле. Кроме того, Faridaily со ссылкой на знакомого с предвыборной социологией собеседника сообщал о закрытом июльском опросе ФОМ, в котором «Яблоко» получило 5,5% по стране и по 11% в Москве и Петербурге. ▪️10 августа Верховный суд отменил регистрацию федерального списка «Яблока», формально удовлетворив иск партии «Родина».

Posting my reply to @_sholtodouglas given that some of my comments about Anthropic on @theallinpod yesterday have been widely discussed here on X and I think the topic is important. Gavin Baker (@GavinSBaker) Sholto, thank you for setting the record straight. Larger issue is that multiple very serious people in Silicon Valley have heard some variation of this and believe it to be true. And the reason it is believable to so many is that it is consistent with Dario’s public messaging and what he outlined in the essay you shared: this technology *might* be dangerous for humans in multiple ways, could lead to extreme concentration of economic power (as outlined in the essay) and therefore needs to be regulated thoughtfully. I agree with the potential risks and I believe Dario makes all of these arguments in good faith. As discussed on the pod, if one agrees that AI *might* be dangerous, there are two ways to address this potential risk. Either concentrate it in the hands of a chosen few companies and politicians via regulation or distribute it widely. Essentially boils down to whether one believes AI is too dangerous to concentrate or too dangerous to distribute. There are reasonable arguments on both sides, but I profoundly agree with Zuckerberg’s statement that: “The notion that AI is so dangerous that the only safe path is an extreme concentration of power seems inherently problematic. Historically, hoping that an absolute power will benevolently provide for humanity if sufficiently enlightened has not led to safe or positive outcomes.” And as Dario says in the aforementioned essay, “some may object that we can simply keep AIs in check with a balance of power between many AI systems, as we do with humans.” I believe this is the best path forward: I want as many AIs as possible to maximize the odds that one shares my own particular values. And as Dario notes, no human has ever been able to take over the world. At this point, I think safe to say that Dario has lost the argument. His messaging has failed to result in his preferred regulatory path. The fact that the only solution to the recent incident where an unreleased advanced OpenAI model hacked Hugging Face was an open-source model likely ended any chance of strict near-term regulation. Essentially every major company other than Anthropic has signed Jensen’s letter. However, Dario’s messaging has been massively helpful to efforts to ban datacenters here in America. I suspect we will see anti-datacenter advocacy groups runnings ads using clips of Dario warning about how dangerous AI could be for humans. His good faith efforts in favor of regulation are now increasing the odds that AI will not be beneficial for Americans and humans everywhere. I believe that there is a reasonable chance AI might help us cure most forms of disease such that we have extended lifespans and can enjoy these long lives in an abundant Star Trek like future. That is the future that I want and I think Dario is decreasing the odds of that future at this point. He is about to be the CEO of one of the most important public companies in the world and given that the pro-regulatory effort has failed (at least for now), I respectfully think he should make an effort to be a more positive advocate for his own industry. And if I am wrong and we do need to regulate this technology, he will be a more effective advocate for this in the future having been open-minded to the alternative. And for the sake of clarity and as I outlined on the pod, I think Anthropic has deep competitive advantages and is an amazing company. Ironically, the main risk I saw to Anthropic a few months ago was nationalization as a result of Dario’s own rhetoric and behavior. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/GavinSBaker/status/2088611616577253502#m

Here is the hard truth: there is 0% of a reason that Canadians should not have as high if not higher standard of living than the citizens of the U.S.A. Indeed, at the end of the last century, Canada had a higher per-capita GDP. There is a precidence to this: a bit over a century ago, Argentina had a standard of living approximate to the U.S.A. as well. We had the same foundation in English Common Law. We are equally blessed with resources, education, and hard working people. Canadian demographics for most of its history was roughly in line with the northern-tier States in the U.S. The difference is that the Canadian people, like the Argentenian people, made a political choice that they doubled down on. They took fell for the lies of the left and never self-corrected. The Canadian people created this on mess. If they wish to correct it, they need to look at the actions and policies since Justin Trudeau and his party took power over a decade ago, throw them away, and take a course correction. I miss the Canada of my youth. James E. Thorne (@DrJStrategy) Canada in Denial Canada’s economic debate is trapped between nostalgia and denial. Policy makers and pundits speak as if Canada has unlimited strategic options while refusing to confront the basic facts of the economy. Canada’s comparative advantage is natural resources: energy, critical minerals, agriculture, forestry and water. That is not an embarrassment to regulate into irrelevance. It is the foundation of a more productive national economy. Canada’s central economic relationship is with the US. Canada needs dependable access to the American market; the US needs secure, nearby access to strategic inputs. The bargain should be straightforward: preferential Canadian access to US consumers and industry in return for preferential American access, including competitive pricing, to Canadian energy, critical minerals, and industrial materials. There is precedent. The original Canada-US free trade agreement included the proportionality clause, which effectively assured the US ongoing access to a share of Canadian energy supplies. Canada should revive that underlying logic, this time deliberately and reciprocally. Washington receives dependable strategic resources. Canada receives market access and deeper continental security co-operation, including through the proposed Golden Dome missile-defence architecture. That is not submission. It is leverage. Canada should also stop pretending it can recreate America’s manufacturing base. Canada does have excellent firms and specialised clusters, but not America’s scale, capital markets, domestic demand, supply-chain depth or defence-industrial ecosystem. Subsidising a broad manufacturing mirage will not change those fundamentals. The 1st best strategy should build on what we possess: resource processing, energy infrastructure, critical-mineral refining, agricultural technology and advanced industrial production. Canada must become easier to build in, invest in and finance, with faster approvals, competitive taxes and policy aimed at productive investment rather than property inflation and consumption. President Trump did not create Canada’s predicament. He did not produce weak productivity, depleted private investment or our failure to build. But Washington has made an overdue assessment: the US cannot indefinitely absorb the world’s excess output and debt while its own living standards stagnate and industrial base hollows out. The Trump administration is confronting distortions that earlier governments deferred. Yes, a Hamilton Clay era of economic policy is the foundation. The attacks on the US ambassador to Canada are embarrassing. They are emblematic of a political and media class more interested in attacking the messenger than confronting Canada’s weak competitiveness and dependence on US market access. The global debt cycle is the forcing function. The era of cheap credit, expanding transfers and asset inflation is ending. Canada needs real growth: more investment, energy, output and productivity. To be clear, economic growth dependent on the public sector crowding out the private sector is NOT the solution! It could lead in AI, especially in mining, energy, and Data Centers, but it lacks the vision to connect technology to its economic strengths. Equalization payments, meanwhile, weaken incentives for provinces to reform, hampering structural adjustments. Canada constrains Alberta’s energy industry through federal industrial and regulatory policy, then uses equalisation to transfer revenues generated by Alberta’s resource economy to provinces that have chosen weaker, less productive policy models. Ottawa impedes the country’s most important source of comparative advantage, then asks it to subsidise the inefficiencies elsewhere. In what rational economic system is that logical? The contradiction is almost comical! Canada’s cautionary tale is Argentina, which is only now trying to escape the long decline created by debt, intervention and economic denial. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/DrJStrategy/status/2088595406393327669#m

महा-डीबीटीवर 29 नवीन योजनांसह आता 105 योजना, लाभार्थ्यांसाठी सुलभता! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे महा-डीबीटी 2.0 अंतर्गत 29 नवीन योजनांचा शुभारंभ करण्यात आला. नागरिकांना विविध शासकीय योजनांचा सुलभतेने लाभ मिळावा, हा या उपक्रमाचा उद्देश असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. राज्यातील नागरिकांना विविध वैयक्तिक योजनांचा लाभ अधिक सुलभ, पारदर्शक आणि प्रभावी पद्धतीने मिळावा, यासाठी महा-डीबीटी पोर्टलवर आज नव्याने 29 योजनांचे लोकार्पण (ऑनबोर्डिंग) करण्यात आले. त्यामुळे महा-डीबीटीवर उपलब्ध योजनांची संख्या आता 105 झाली आहे. याशिवाय आणखी 231 योजनांचे काम प्रक्रियेत असल्याची माहिती देण्यात आली. शासनाच्या उर्वरित सर्व योजनाही टप्प्याटप्प्याने या एकाच व्यासपीठावर आणण्याचा प्रयत्न असून, त्याद्वारे नागरिकांना शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ घेणे अधिक सोपे होईल, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. महा-डीबीटीची व्यवस्था सुरू झाल्यापासून शासनाच्या विविध योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता आणि उत्तरदायित्व वाढले असून, योजनांचा गैरवापर लक्षणीयरीत्या कमी झाला आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पात्र लाभार्थ्यांपर्यंत थेट आणि योग्य पद्धतीने लाभ पोहोचविण्यासाठी डिजिटल प्रणाली अधिक सक्षम करण्यावर शासनाचा भर आहे. शासनाच्या ‘सेकंड जनरेशन रिफॉर्म्स’ अंतर्गत महा-डीबीटी व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम, कार्यक्षम आणि विश्वासार्ह करण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. विविध विभागांच्या योजनांचे टप्प्याटप्प्याने ऑनबोर्डिंग करण्यात येत असून, भविष्यात शासनाच्या सर्व प्रमुख योजना या एकाच डिजिटल व्यासपीठावर उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. त्यामुळे नागरिकांना वेगवेगळ्या कार्यालयांमध्ये किंवा पोर्टलवर जाण्याची आवश्यकता कमी होऊन सेवा वितरण अधिक सुलभ होईल. आज शुभारंभ करण्यात आलेल्या 29 योजनांमध्ये इतर मागासवर्गीय विभाग तसेच उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभागाच्या योजनांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनांची महा-डीबीटीवर यशस्वीपणे सुरुवात केल्याबद्दल मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी संबंधित दोन्ही विभागांचे अभिनंदन केले. शासकीय सेवा आणि योजनांचा लाभ नागरिकांना घरबसल्या अथवा जवळच्या सेवा केंद्रातून कमीत कमी अडचणींसह मिळावा, यासाठी भविष्यातही नागरिककेंद्री डिजिटल सुधारणांना अधिक वेग देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. महा-डीबीटी 2.0 विविध योजनांसाठी एकाच ठिकाणी अर्ज करण्याची सुविधा नागरिककेंद्रित एकात्मिक प्रणाली महा-डीबीटी 2.0 ने दिली आहे. सिंगल साइन-ऑन, रिअल-टाइम मॉनिटरिंगसाठी लाईव्ह डॅशबोर्ड आणि ‘नो युवर बेनिफिट’ यांसारख्या सुविधा या पोर्टलमध्ये उपलब्ध आहेत. ऑफलाईन प्रक्रियेतून ऑनलाइन प्रक्रियेकडे संक्रमण करताना मंजुरीची प्रक्रिया सुलभ करण्यावर तसेच नवीन योजना समाविष्ट करण्यासाठी लागणारा वेळ कमी करण्यावर भर देण्यात आला आहे. पोर्टलवर आधार कार्ड आधारित पडताळणी, एंड-टू-एंड डिजिटल प्रक्रिया आणि पारदर्शक थेट लाभ हस्तांतरण (डीबीटी) यामुळे योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता व उत्तरदायित्व वाढण्यास मदत होणार आहे. यावेळी मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार व इतर वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @ShelarAshish #Maharashtra On a Navy ship, Mom can’t just call the Captain, but on a Merchant Marine ship, they can. I’ve taken more than a few of these calls over the years. I would bring the sailor up to my office and have a big family meeting on speaker phone to address her complaints. 8/10 the kid would apologize after hanging up. Usually, he would say something like “sorry, my mom just worries a lot. I told her a few things and she made it a big deal.” 1/10 the kid just really didn’t want to be there and was looking for an excuse to quit, which was easy to provide…. usually with mom’s help. 1/10 there were some serious problems at home, and I’d send him off on the next helicopter to go deal with it. This frustrated the heck out of me for years until I went to a funeral and stayed with a friends family. This family is among the most loving and supportive people I know, but once the door closed at home, all they did all weekend was complain to their mom and listen to her worry about everything they said. Was it healthy? No. Was it stressful? Yes. But the mom’s dad grew up in an orphanage, and the dad grew up poor. Like lost siblings poor. It’s the way they learned to communicate their love. It’s not great, but on a ship with over 5,000, in combat, on an extended deployment… it’s zero surprise to me that some moms are worried and some kids complain to them. Maybe the Navy should invest a few million in helping families understand the power of positive thinking. IDK. What I do know is a kid losing weight and Mom drawing worried conclusions from that is not at all uncommon. It’s certainly not the major news story Jim wants it to be. We are at war. You know what would be a major news story? Combat casualties. But unfortunately for Jim, the naval operation is running too smoothly for now. Jim Acosta (@Acosta) It’s not just happening on the USS Abraham Lincoln. The mother of a sailor who served aboard the USS Tripoli sent me text messages about the poor living conditions her son experienced. If social media posts of Judge Hamayoun Dilawar are authentic (Tosha Khana Case Judge), this is alarming and raises serious and reasonable doubts on credibility of trial being conducted by him. In my view, propriety demands that he should immediately recuse or disassociate himself from the case. It needs to be noted that Seven Member Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in Malik Qayyum Case (reported in 2001 PLD SC 568) held that bias on part of the judge vitiates judicial proceedings. The court further held that an accused has a right of a fair trial by a judicial minded person, not by someone functioning under an influence or bias as the same paralyses his judicial faculties to conduct fair trial. Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

#WATCH | Ranchi, Jharkhand: Student leader Devendra Nath Mahto says, "Today is a proud day for India. Today is Independence Day, and I wish to celebrate this glorious day, even in my final moments. Students had made preparations for the flag-hoisting ceremony at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium. We had also provided written notification to the DC, the SDM, and the hospital management regarding this... By 9 AM, the administration and hospital management stated that they would let me go to hoist the flag. Then, within 20-21 minutes, they initially said a vehicle was arriving to take us there, but suddenly, we were attacked. The police pounced on us in a highly aggressive manner. They wanted to force us inside and lock us in with full might... I pleaded with them not to lock the door or close the gate. At that point, the entire police force pounced on us, and the companions who were trying to protect me were brutally beaten and thrown to the ground..." He adds, "I am on a hunger strike for 14 days. I have somehow been holding on, breathing, and surviving, sustained by love and blessings. I am talking about reforming the education system. On Independence Day, 80 years after gaining independence, it deeply distresses me to see this. Is this the nation envisioned through the sacrifices of Bhagat Singh and Subhash Chandra Bose? Is this the nation of Ambedkar's and Gandhi's dreams? What is my crime? I am merely trying to improve the education system. I am following the paths of Gandhi, Bhagat Singh, and Ambedkar. Today, on Independence Day, I expressed a desire to hoist the flag and participate in the Tiranga Yatra. Is that such a grave crime? It has been six hours now, and I am lying here in this corridor. Speaking is causing strain on my heart. If I have made a mistake, committed a crime, or am at fault, then the government should take action against me... I will accept that. But if I am not at fault, then I want justice... I, Devendra Nath Mahto, whether I live or die is not what matters... If one man dies, it makes no difference; there should be no chaos or public outrage over it. I will remain on this bed until I receive an answer..." Video

महा-डीबीटीवर 29 नवीन योजनांसह आता 105 योजना, लाभार्थ्यांसाठी सुलभता! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे महा-डीबीटी 2.0 अंतर्गत 29 नवीन योजनांचा शुभारंभ करण्यात आला. नागरिकांना विविध शासकीय योजनांचा सुलभतेने लाभ मिळावा, हा या उपक्रमाचा उद्देश असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. राज्यातील नागरिकांना विविध वैयक्तिक योजनांचा लाभ अधिक सुलभ, पारदर्शक आणि प्रभावी पद्धतीने मिळावा, यासाठी महा-डीबीटी पोर्टलवर आज नव्याने 29 योजनांचे लोकार्पण (ऑनबोर्डिंग) करण्यात आले. त्यामुळे महा-डीबीटीवर उपलब्ध योजनांची संख्या आता 105 झाली आहे. याशिवाय आणखी 231 योजनांचे काम प्रक्रियेत असल्याची माहिती देण्यात आली. शासनाच्या उर्वरित सर्व योजनाही टप्प्याटप्प्याने या एकाच व्यासपीठावर आणण्याचा प्रयत्न असून, त्याद्वारे नागरिकांना शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ घेणे अधिक सोपे होईल, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. महा-डीबीटीची व्यवस्था सुरू झाल्यापासून शासनाच्या विविध योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता आणि उत्तरदायित्व वाढले असून, योजनांचा गैरवापर लक्षणीयरीत्या कमी झाला आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पात्र लाभार्थ्यांपर्यंत थेट आणि योग्य पद्धतीने लाभ पोहोचविण्यासाठी डिजिटल प्रणाली अधिक सक्षम करण्यावर शासनाचा भर आहे. शासनाच्या ‘सेकंड जनरेशन रिफॉर्म्स’ अंतर्गत महा-डीबीटी व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम, कार्यक्षम आणि विश्वासार्ह करण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. विविध विभागांच्या योजनांचे टप्प्याटप्प्याने ऑनबोर्डिंग करण्यात येत असून, भविष्यात शासनाच्या सर्व प्रमुख योजना या एकाच डिजिटल व्यासपीठावर उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. त्यामुळे नागरिकांना वेगवेगळ्या कार्यालयांमध्ये किंवा पोर्टलवर जाण्याची आवश्यकता कमी होऊन सेवा वितरण अधिक सुलभ होईल. आज शुभारंभ करण्यात आलेल्या 29 योजनांमध्ये इतर मागासवर्गीय विभाग तसेच उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभागाच्या योजनांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनांची महा-डीबीटीवर यशस्वीपणे सुरुवात केल्याबद्दल मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी संबंधित दोन्ही विभागांचे अभिनंदन केले. शासकीय सेवा आणि योजनांचा लाभ नागरिकांना घरबसल्या अथवा जवळच्या सेवा केंद्रातून कमीत कमी अडचणींसह मिळावा, यासाठी भविष्यातही नागरिककेंद्री डिजिटल सुधारणांना अधिक वेग देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. महा-डीबीटी 2.0 विविध योजनांसाठी एकाच ठिकाणी अर्ज करण्याची सुविधा नागरिककेंद्रित एकात्मिक प्रणाली महा-डीबीटी 2.0 ने दिली आहे. सिंगल साइन-ऑन, रिअल-टाइम मॉनिटरिंगसाठी लाईव्ह डॅशबोर्ड आणि ‘नो युवर बेनिफिट’ यांसारख्या सुविधा या पोर्टलमध्ये उपलब्ध आहेत. ऑफलाईन प्रक्रियेतून ऑनलाइन प्रक्रियेकडे संक्रमण करताना मंजुरीची प्रक्रिया सुलभ करण्यावर तसेच नवीन योजना समाविष्ट करण्यासाठी लागणारा वेळ कमी करण्यावर भर देण्यात आला आहे. पोर्टलवर आधार कार्ड आधारित पडताळणी, एंड-टू-एंड डिजिटल प्रक्रिया आणि पारदर्शक थेट लाभ हस्तांतरण (डीबीटी) यामुळे योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता व उत्तरदायित्व वाढण्यास मदत होणार आहे. यावेळी मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार व इतर वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @ShelarAshish #Maharashtra Ito ang nagdurugtong mula sa Barangay Hagan patungo sa komunidad ng mga katutubo sa Sitio Naswak sa Barangay Lisap. Mahalaga rin ang ginagampanan ng tulay para madala sa kabayanan ang mga produkto ng mga katutubo. तरुणाईच्या नव्या विचारांनी प्रशासनाला नवी दिशा मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत मुख्यमंत्री फेलोशिप कार्यक्रम सत्कार व शुभारंभ सोहळा 2026 पार पडला. मुख्यमंत्री फेलोशिप कार्यक्रमामुळे प्रशासनाला नव्या पिढीचा दृष्टिकोन, नावीन्यपूर्ण कल्पना आणि तंत्रज्ञानाची जोड मिळेल. फेलोंनी फेलोशिपच्या अनुभवातून आपल्या कार्यक्षेत्रात परिवर्तन घडविण्याचे काम करावे. विकसित महाराष्ट्र आणि विकसित भारताच्या निर्मितीत युवा पिढीची भूमिका महत्त्वपूर्ण असल्याचे नमूद करून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सरकारमध्ये अनुभवी आणि गुणवत्तापूर्ण अधिकारी असले तरी दीर्घकाळ एकाच पद्धतीने काम करताना कल्पकता आणि ग्राउंडशी असलेला संपर्क काही प्रमाणात कमी होऊ शकतो. त्यामुळे प्रशासनात नवे विचार आणणे आणि त्याचवेळी तरुणांना शासनाची कार्यपद्धती समजून देणे, हा फेलोशिप कार्यक्रमाचा प्रमुख उद्देश आहे. ‘फेलोशिप’ हा एकतर्फी अनुभव नसून फेलोंकडून प्रशासनालाही नवे विचार आणि दृष्टिकोन मिळतो. नवीन पिढीच्या आकांक्षा आणि कार्यपद्धती समजून घेतल्याशिवाय सर्वसमावेशक प्रशासन शक्य नाही. त्यामुळे प्रशासनाने बदल स्वीकारत अधिक गतिमान होणे आवश्यक आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. सीएम फेलोंनी स्टार्टअप धोरण, महाराष्ट्र स्टेट इनोव्हेशन सोसायटी, जिल्हास्तरीय वॉर रूम्स, विविध डॅशबोर्ड्स, जलयुक्त शिवाराचे जीआयएस मॅपिंग, ‘मागेल त्याला शेततळे’, ई-गव्हर्नन्स, तक्रार निवारण व्यवस्था, चॅटबॉट्स तसेच महाराष्ट्र युनिक इन्फ्रा आयडी यांसारख्या उपक्रमांमध्ये महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान दिल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. प्रशासनामध्ये बदलासाठी केवळ शासन निर्णयाची वाट पाहण्याची आवश्यकता नाही. लोकाभिमुख आणि सोपी कार्यपद्धती आधी स्वीकारून त्यानुसार शासन निर्णय करण्याची नवी कार्यसंस्कृती विकसित झाली पाहिजे, असे #WIONWings with @crypttor | This Independence Day, Wings celebrates India through food, history, festivals and wildlife. What does Delhi taste like when you travel back more than a century? We visit five iconic establishments that were serving customers long before India gained independence. Step inside Wenger’s in Connaught Place, dating back to 1926; experience the famous parathas of Old Delhi; visit Kwality, which opened in 1940; cool down at Kuremal Mohan Lal Kulfi Wale, whose story dates to 1908; and sample the flavours of Shyam Sweets, established in 1910. From cakes and kulfi to parathas and classic restaurant fare, these establishments offer a delicious connection to Delhi’s past. This Independence Day, visit the places where Indian history was made. We travel to the Red Fort in New Delhi, Gandhi Smriti, Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad, Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar and the Partition Museum to understand the people and events that shaped modern India. The celebrations continue beyond Independence Day. We look ahead to some of India’s biggest upcoming festivals, including Onam, Janmashtami and Ganesh Chaturthi, and the destinations where travellers can experience them. India is home to the majority of the world’s wild tigers, making its reserves some of the most important wildlife destinations on Earth. Following a new government report highlighting India’s tiger conservation efforts, we journey through Ranthambore National Park, Satpura Tiger Reserve and Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, exploring how conservation and responsible tourism can help protect the country's most famous big cat. From eateries that predate independence to landmarks of the freedom movement and forests protecting India's extraordinary wildlife, celebrate India with Wings. #IndependenceDay #DelhiFood #IncredibleIndia #TigerConservation Video

I was very pleased to welcome @UNESCO_DG Khaled El-Enany on his first visit to Ukraine as Director-General of UNESCO. I expressed gratitude for this important visit, his participation in events marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra, and UNESCO’s continued support for Ukraine. I’m confident that Director-General’s visit would provide additional impetus to further strengthening our cooperation and is an important step in Ukraine-UNESCO relations. Following Russia’s latest deadly attacks, we focused on the protection of Ukraine’s cultural heritage, including the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra, and UNESCO’s continued monitoring of Ukraine’s World Heritage sites threatened and damaged by Russian deliberate strikes. Culture, education, science, and historical heritage are foundations of our identity and national resilience, as well as integral elements of Ukraine’s security. Russia understands their importance very well. This is precisely why it targets them as part of its broader aggression against our country. We value UNESCO’s role in mobilizing international support for Ukraine and discussed how to deepen our cooperation across these areas. Ukraine, for its part, will continue actively contributing to UNESCO’s work and strengthening international mechanisms for protecting cultural heritage in times of armed conflict. We took a look back at the history of Ukraine-UNESCO relations through a special exhibition of archival documents. We also drew Director-General El-Enany’s particular attention to the Archive of the Ukrainian Republican Capella (1919–1929), recently nominated for inscription on UNESCO’s Memory of the World International Register. I thanked Director-General El-Enany for his personal engagement and leadership. We count on UNESCO’s continued principled voice, practical support, and firm response to Russia’s attacks against Ukrainian culture, education, and science. Russia must be held accountable for these crimes.
